old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a steaming tray containing several cooked lobsters. The lobsters are bright red, indicating they have been boiled or steamed to perfection. Steam rises from the hot lobsters, suggesting they are freshly prepared. The background is slightly blurred, drawing attention to the lobsters in the foreground. The lighting is dim, creating a cozy atmosphere. The scene is static, with no camera movement, and the lobsters remain in the same position throughout.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a steaming tray containing several cooked lobsters. The lobsters are bright red, indicating they have been boiled or steamed to perfection. The camera slowly pans around the tray, capturing the steam rising from the hot lobsters, which suggests they are freshly prepared and ready to be served. The background is slightly blurred, drawing attention to the lobsters in the foreground. The lighting is dim, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The camera movement is smooth and deliberate, allowing viewers to appreciate the details of the lobsters' texture and color. As the camera continues to pan, it reveals more lobsters in the tray, emphasizing the abundance and freshness of the seafood. The overall scene conveys a sense of warmth and culinary delight, making the viewer anticipate the delicious meal that awaits.
caption: A perforated stainless-steel steamer insert cradles several bright-red cooked lobsters, their claws bound with green and tan ties, set inside a larger dark pan against a smudged grey metal wall. Wisps of steam curl upward from the tray, their shape and density shifting continuously while the lobsters remain still relative to the metal. One large body lies across the centre, a deep-red tail rests toward the lower right, and claw clusters bunch at the left. The framing drifts slowly, sliding the tray and its contents leftward and lifting the far rim higher. As this drift progresses, a second, empty, bright metal pan enters view along the right edge. Exposure shifts modestly, with mid-frames appearing darker and the newly revealed pan catching more light. The lobsters keep their fixed positions relative to one another and to the tray walls. Steam continues rising and the tray keeps sliding toward the left edge as the excerpt runs on.
